en.title: EU budget summit collapses over Ukraine funding dispute
en.dek: EU leaders failed to agree a seven-year budget after Germany and frugal countries walked out over Ukraine funding, pushing a deal to December.
facts: The EU budget summit on the seven-year budget collapsed on 27 November 2026.
Germany and "frugal" countries walked out of the talks.
The dispute centered on how to fund Ukraine.
A deal was pushed to December.
DW reported that divisions deepened between member states after the summit.
Euronews reported the collapse as Spain prepared for a vote and the UK unveiled a deal.
body: The EU budget summit collapsed on 27 November 2026 after leaders failed to agree on a seven-year budget. DW reported that divisions deepened between member states following the tense summit.
Euronews reported that Germany and "frugal" countries walked out of the talks. The walkout pushed a deal to December.
Leaders could not agree on how to fund Ukraine, according to DW. The dispute over Ukraine funding caused the summit to fall apart.
Spain braced for a vote and the UK unveiled a deal, according to Euronews. The budget negotiations ended without an agreement.
Germany and the frugal states left the room over the Ukraine funding question. Their departure removed any chance of an immediate deal.
December is the new target for a budget agreement, according to Euronews. The seven-year budget remains unapproved.
DW reported that the tense summit deepened divisions between EU member states. Ukraine funding remained the central point of disagreement.
en.context: The EU budget summit addressed a seven-year budget framework. According to DW, divisions between member states deepened after the tense meeting. Euronews reported that a deal was pushed to December.

en.headline: EU budget summit collapses over Ukraine funding dispute
en.body: EU leaders summit on seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine, DW reports. Germany and "frugal" countries walked out, pushing a deal to December, Euronews reports.

de.headline: EU-Gipfel über Ukraine-Finanzierung geplatzt
de.body: Der EU-Gipfel zu einem siebenjährigen Haushalt ist wegen Uneinigkeiten über die Finanzierung der Ukraine geplatzt. Deutschland und die "sparenden" Länder sind ausgestiegen, ein Abkommen wurde auf Dezember verschoben, berichtet Euronews.

es.headline: Cumbre presupuestaria de la UE colapsa por disputa por financiación de Ucrania
es.body: La cumbre de líderes de la UE sobre el presupuesto a siete años se disolvió por divisiones sobre cómo financiar Ucrania, informa DW. Alemania y los países "frugales" se retiraron, retrasando un acuerdo a diciembre, informa Euronews.

pt.headline: Cimeira orçamental da UE falha sobre disputa de financiamento da Ucrânia
pt.body: A cimeira de líderes da UE sobre o orçamento de sete anos desmoronou-se em divisões sobre como financiar a Ucrânia, segundo a DW. Alemanha e países "frugais" retiraram-se, adiando um acordo para dezembro, segundo a Euronews.

it.headline: Vertice sul bilancio UE fallito sulla disputa per il finanziamento dell'Ucraina
it.body: Il summit dei leader UE sul bilancio pluriennale è crollato a causa delle divisioni su come finanziare l'Ucraina, secondo DW. Germania e i paesi "frugali" sono usciti, rimandando un accordo a dicembre, secondo Euronews.

fr.headline: Sommet budgétaire de l'UE s'effondre sur le litige de financement de l'Ukraine
fr.body: Le sommet des dirigeants de l'UE sur le budget à sept ans a volé en éclat à cause de divisions sur le financement de l'Ukraine, rapporte DW. L'Allemagne et les pays "frugaux" sont sortis, repoussant un accord à décembre, selon Euronews.

zh.headline: 欧盟预算峰会因乌克兰资金争议破裂
zh.body: 据德国之声报道，欧盟领导人就七年期预算举行的峰会因在如何资助乌克兰问题上存在分歧而破裂。据欧洲新闻台报道，德国和“节俭”国家离席，将协议推迟至12月。

ja.headline: EU予算サミット、ウクライナへの資金提供巡る対立で決裂
ja.body: 7カ年予算を巡るEU首脳サミットは、ウクライナへの資金提供方法をめぐる分裂により決裂したとDWが報じた。ドイツと「倹約派」諸国が退席し、合意は12月に先送りされたとユーロニュースが報じた。

ko.headline: EU 예산 정상회의, 우크라이나 지원금 분쟁으로 결렬
ko.body: EU 지도자들의 7개년 예산 정상회의가 우크라이나 지원 방식을 둘러싼 이견으로 결렬됐다고 DW가 보도했다. 독일과 'frugal' 국가들이 퇴장하면서 합의는 12월로 미뤄졌다고 Euronews가 전했다.
